Messages.Body:
gray...@my-deja.com wrote:
> When vamp B takes over vamp A's action using Mask of 1000 Faces is
> vamp A considered to have taken the action? ( mainly for purposes of
> the NRA ). I'd say no, but I thought I should check.

See the online rulings:

No Repeat Actions (V:EKN)
* The acting minion when the action resolves (blocked or successful)
becomes unable to perform the same type of action again this turn
(if the "No Repeat Actions" V:EKN special floor rule is being used).
[RTR 20-MAR-1997]
